title: Target search steps
description: Value of --search-steps on supported commands that work with targets. Name only the targeting methods the command acts on.

semantic.description: Natural-language description of the element. Supported on the target only, never on an anchor.

value.description: The selector or description to store.

text.description: The text matched at runtime. '*' matches zero or more characters, '?' exactly one; bare text is a case-insensitive substring. An empty string clears a seeded override.

occurrence.description: 1-based occurrence index used to disambiguate duplicate matches, counted top-to-bottom then left-to-right. 0 matches any.

accuracy.description: OCR text matching accuracy. Raise it to require a near-exact match when similar labels collide.

imageMethod.description: Always '{}'. Image matching requires a Windows project - the method is unavailable in cross-platform projects - and is supported on selector- and image-based targets only, for activities that can search by image.
